description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC Controller class managing shipping configuration related endpoints in an e-commerce application. It handles displaying current shipping settings, saving updates, and managing supported countries for shipping.

classes.name: ShippingConfigsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing shipping configuration endpoints, including viewing and editing shipping settings, and updating supported countries.

methods.name: displayShippingConfigs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the shipping configuration page with current settings.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updates to shipping configuration settings.

methods.name: pageCountries
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch a paginated list of countries, marking which are supported for shipping.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update support status for a specific country.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set menu attributes in the model for UI navigation.
